research_question: Can verifier-backed workflow control and selective recovery improve reliable task completion under controlled failures compared with a minimal agent runtime, and what additional execution cost does that reliability require?

metric_definitions.false_completion_rate: runs where claimed completion is false / valid runs
metric_definitions.recovery_success_rate: eventually externally verified recovery runs / runs where eligible recovery was required or attempted
metric_definitions.cost_per_verified_completion: total measured execution cost / verified completions; NOT_MEASURED when price is unavailable or denominator is zero
metric_definitions.duplicate_side_effect_rate: runs with unintended duplicate externally observable side effect / valid runs
metric_definitions.lost_work_rate: eligible recovery runs with lost or unnecessarily redone pre-failure valid work / eligible recovery runs
